LanguageData.ABY_RiftButcher.label: rift butcher
LanguageData.ABY_RiftButcher.description: A hovering Dominion-severance execution frame built to cut battle lines apart after the colony survives army-scale horde pressure. Its hook snare and surgical cleaver force defenders to move instead of hiding behind one static firing lane.
LanguageData.ABY_RiftButcher.tools.0.label: severance cleaver
LanguageData.ABY_RiftButcher.tools.1.label: chain hook
LanguageData.ABY_RiftButcherSigil.label: rift butcher sigil
LanguageData.ABY_RiftButcherSigil.description: A severance wafer keyed to the first post-horde line-breaker. Carry it to an abyssal summoning circle after containing a horde gate to route the Rift Butcher into the colony's defensive perimeter.
LanguageData.ABY_RiftButcherSeveranceCore.label: severance core
LanguageData.ABY_RiftButcherSeveranceCore.description: A ribbed Dominion wound-core torn from the Rift Butcher. It is not just a trophy; it is a routing proof that the colony survived a surgical line-breaker and may risk deeper dominion access.
